title: Loki
blocks: What he wanted
To rule. First Asgard, then Earth, which he invaded with Thanos's Chitauri army in The Avengers.
How it ended
The Avengers beat him in New York. He slowly turned into a hero across the Thor films and his own series.
lead: He's the one holding every timeline together, and he's on the heroes' side in Doomsday.

title: Ultron
blocks: What he wanted
Tony and Bruce built him with the Mind Stone to protect the world. He decided the only way to save Earth was to wipe out humanity.
How it ended
The Avengers stopped him in Sokovia, and Vision destroyed his last body.

title: Hela
blocks: What she wanted
Odin's firstborn and the Goddess of Death. She wanted the throne of Asgard and an empire across the Nine Realms.
How it ended
Thor let Surtur destroy Asgard to stop her, and her with it.
lead: She crushed Mjolnir with one hand, one of the most shocking moments in the Thor films.

title: Thanos
blocks: What he wanted
To wipe out half of all life to “balance” the universe.
How it ended
He won in Infinity War. Thor killed him afterward, and a 2014 version who came to 2023 was snapped away by Tony.
lead: The villain the whole Infinity Saga built toward, and the standard every big bad gets compared to.

title: Dormammu
blocks: What he wanted
The ruler of the Dark Dimension, hungry to absorb Earth.
How it ended
Strange trapped him in a time loop until he agreed to leave.
lead: Clea, introduced in Multiverse of Madness, is tied to the Dark Dimension in the comics.

title: He Who Remains & Kang
blocks: What they wanted
He Who Remains wanted to keep one timeline to stop his variants. Kang the Conqueror wanted to escape exile and rule.
How it ended
He Who Remains was killed by Sylvie. Kang was beaten in the Quantum Realm, but a Council of Kangs was waiting.
lead: Marvel dropped Kang as the saga's main villain in 2024.

title: Galactus
blocks: What he wanted
A giant cosmic being who eats planets to survive. He offered to spare Earth-828 if Reed and Sue gave him their baby, Franklin.
How it ended
The Fantastic Four used Franklin as bait and sent Galactus away, with help from the Silver Surfer.
lead: He showed how powerful Franklin is, and that's exactly what Doom seems interested in.

title: Doctor Doom
blocks: Who he is
Victor von Doom, ruler of Latveria, a genius scientist and sorcerer, and one of Marvel's greatest villains. Robert Downey Jr. plays him.
What we know
He appeared to Franklin on Earth-828 in First Steps. Marvel says he's not a Tony Stark variant.
lead: He's the villain of both Doomsday (Dec 18, 2026) and Secret Wars (Dec 17, 2027).
